empty.description: Review mode: shown in the panel when there is nothing to review.

hint.description: Review mode: the keys of the list, above it. N, P, K, Delete and the arrows are key names: keep them as they are.

place.topLeft.description: Review mode: where in the frame an automatic zoom aims, in thirds, inside a row title ("Zoom in on a click, {place}"). Lower case.

place.top.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims (the top middle third), inside a row title. Lower case.

place.topRight.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims, inside a row title. Lower case.

place.left.description: Review mode: where in the frame a zoom aims (the middle left third), inside a row title. Lower case.

zoom.click.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic zoom made at a mouse click.

zoom.clickAt.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic zoom made at a mouse click; {place} says where in the frame ("top right").

layout.corner.topRight.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change that moved the camera bubble to the top right corner.

layout.corner.bottomRight.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change that moved the camera bubble to the bottom right corner.

layout.cameraLarge.description: Review mode: the title of an automatic change to a large camera over the screen.

cut.retake.description: Review mode: the title of a cut that removed a retake (a sentence said again); {said} is the words removed, as said.

cut.repeat.description: Review mode: the title of a cut that removed repeated words; {said} is the words removed.

cut.words.description: Review mode: the title of a cut that removed filler words; {said} is the words removed.

cut.short.description: Review mode: the title of a cut Make a shorter version made; {seconds} is how much was cut ("2.4 s").

cut.silence.description: Review mode: the title of a silence that was cut; {seconds} is its length ("2.4 s").

cut.idle.description: Review mode: the title of idle time (no typing or clicks) that was cut; {seconds} is its length.

sped.silence.description: Review mode: the title of a silence played faster; {seconds} is its length, {factor} how many times as fast ("Sped up 2.4 s of silence 4×").

sped.idle.description: Review mode: the title of idle time played faster; {seconds} is its length, {factor} how many times as fast.

cutBy.silences.description: Review mode: the tool that made a cut, after the time on its row: the Remove silences tool.

cutBy.polish.description: Review mode: the tool that made a cut: Polish in one click.

cutBy.smartSpeed.description: Review mode: the tool that made a cut or speed-up: Smart speed (idle time).

cutBy.filler.description: Review mode: what a word cut removed: filler words ("um", "uh").

cutBy.retake.description: Review mode: what a word cut removed: a retake (a sentence said again).

cutBy.repeat.description: Review mode: what a word cut removed: repeated words.

cutBy.short.description: Review mode: the tool that made a cut: Make a shorter version.

progress.description: Review mode: how many automatic changes have been kept or removed so far, of all of them.

row.name.description: Review mode: what a screen reader says for a row: its title, its kind, its time in the video, the tool that made it and its status ("Cut 2.4 s of silence, silence, at 0:12.4, Polish, not reviewed").

acted.keep.description: Review mode: said to screen readers after one change was kept.

acted.remove.description: Review mode: said to screen readers after one change was removed.

bulk.removed.description: Review mode: said after Remove all; {things} is a count of changes of one kind ("5 zooms").

stillBusy.removing.description: Review mode: said when Remove all is pressed while it still works; {things} is a count ("5399 silence cuts").

wait.removeDuringRemoveAll.description: Review mode: said when a row's Remove is pressed while Remove all works.

stale.alreadyRemoved.description: Review mode: said when a Remove that waited finds its change already removed meanwhile.

stale.notKept.description: Review mode: said when a Keep that waited finds its change removed meanwhile.

stale.notRemoved.description: Review mode: said when a Remove that waited finds its change kept meanwhile.

stopped.keepAll.description: The editor's notice when closing Review mode stopped Keep all before it was done.

stopped.removeAll.description: The editor's notice when closing Review mode stopped Remove all before it was done; {action} is the button's name ("Remove all silence cuts", "Remove all").

busyWord.keep.description: Review mode: the Keep all button while it works.

busyWord.remove.description: Review mode: the Remove all button while it works.

button.none.description: The title bar's Review button, for screen readers, when every automatic change was reviewed.

button.label.description: The title bar's Review button: opens Review mode (a verb: check the automatic changes).

versions.error.keepFirst.description: Versions: why a version could not be opened, inside "Could not open this version: {error}" (lower case first): the edit now is always kept first; {reason} says why that failed.

versions.error.open.description: Versions: shown when a version could not be opened; {error} is the reason.

versions.error.rename.description: Versions: shown when a version could not be renamed; {error} is the reason.

versions.deleted.description: The editor's notice after a version was deleted; {name} is the version's name.

versions.error.delete.description: Versions: shown when a version could not be deleted; {error} is the reason.

versions.title.description: The Versions dialog's title: saved copies of the edit to go back to.

versions.intro.description: Versions: the line under the title that says what a version is.

versions.nameField.description: Versions: the name field's label for screen readers.

versions.save.description: Versions: the button that keeps the edit as a new version.

versions.full.description: Versions: shown when the most versions one project keeps are saved; {n} is that number (50).

versions.empty.description: Versions: shown when the project has no versions.

versions.list.description: Versions: the list's name for screen readers.

versions.renameField.description: Versions: the rename field's label; {name} is the version's name now.

versions.automatic.description: Versions: a badge on a version Flown kept by itself before a big change.

versions.openName.description: Versions: the Open button's name for screen readers; {name} is the version's name.

versions.open.description: Versions: the button that opens a version in place of the edit now (a verb).

versions.compareName.description: Versions: the Compare button's name for screen readers; {name} is the version's name.

versions.compare.description: Versions: the button that shows how a version differs from the edit now (a verb).

versions.renameName.description: Versions: the Rename button's name for screen readers; {name} is the version's name.

versions.rename.description: Versions: the button that renames a version (a verb).

versions.deleteAsk.description: Versions: the delete question's name for screen readers; {name} is the version's name.

versions.deleteQuestion.description: Versions: the question before a version is deleted; {name} is its name. Its buttons are Delete and Keep.

versions.autoHint.description: Versions: the footer: the tools before which Flown keeps a version by itself, and how many such versions it keeps ({n}, 5). Polish, Make my captions great, Remove all, the Transcript tab, Review and Make a vertical or square version are the names of tools and buttons.

versions.comparing.description: Versions: shown while a version is compared with the edit now.

versions.error.compare.description: Versions: shown when a version could not be compared; {error} is the reason.

versions.same.description: Versions: the comparison when nothing differs.

versions.what.description: Versions: the comparison table's first column, for screen readers: what each row counts.

versions.thisVersion.description: Versions: the comparison table's column of the version's values.

versions.now.description: Versions: the comparison table's column of the edit now's values.

versions.alsoDifferent.description: Versions: under the comparison table, the other parts of the edit that differ; {areas} lists them ("style, camera and zooms").

versions.different.description: Versions: the parts of the edit that differ when no count does; {areas} lists them ("style, camera and zooms").

polish.step.style.description: Polish in one click: the name of a step (a row of the dialog and of its summary): the look: background, frame, cursor and zoom style.

polish.step.zoom.description: Polish in one click: the name of a step (a row of the dialog and of its summary): turning auto zoom on.

polish.step.silences.description: Polish in one click: the name of a step (a row of the dialog and of its summary): cutting or speeding up pauses.

polish.step.smoothCuts.description: Polish in one click: the name of a step (a row of the dialog and of its summary): crossfades and punch-ins at the cuts.

polish.step.captions.description: Polish in one click: the name of a step (a row of the dialog and of its summary): making captions.

polish.step.chapters.description: Polish in one click: the name of a step (a row of the dialog and of its summary): finding chapters.

polish.step.captionLook.description: Polish in one click: the name of a step (a row of the dialog and of its summary): the captions' style, emphasis and pop-ups.

polish.step.director.description: Polish in one click: the name of a step (a row of the dialog and of its summary): the automatic camera director.

polish.silence.cut.description: Polish in one click: a Silence action chip: pauses are cut out (not played faster).

polish.silence.cutHint.description: Polish in one click: the tooltip of the Cut chip.

polish.silence.x2.description: Polish in one click: the tooltip of the 2× chip.

polish.silence.x4.description: Polish in one click: the tooltip of the 4× chip.

polish.silence.x8.description: Polish in one click: the tooltip of the 8× chip.

polish.title.description: The Polish in one click dialog's title: it runs the automatic edits in one go.

polish.lead.description: Polish in one click: the line under the title.

polish.footnote.description: Polish in one click: under the summary of what changed.

polish.nothingChosen.description: Polish in one click: the Polish button's tooltip when no step is on.

polish.lookingForProviders.description: Polish in one click: the Captions row while the AI services are read.

polish.keepLook.description: Polish in one click: the Style menu's first choice: no style preset is applied.

polish.changedSince.description: Polish in one click: why Undo polish is off: the video was edited after the polish.

polish.cancelled.description: The editor's notice after Polish in one click was cancelled while it ran.

polish.undone.description: The editor's notice after Undo polish.

polish.buttonTitle.description: The title bar's Polish button's tooltip: what Polish in one click does.

polish.failed.description: Polish in one click: shown when planning the polish failed; {reason} is the error.

polish.unknownError.description: Polish in one click: the reason shown when an error has no message, inside "Polish failed: {reason}." (lower case).

polish.hint.style.description: Polish in one click: what the Style step does.

polish.hint.zoomOn.description: Polish in one click: the Auto zoom step when auto zoom is on already.

polish.hint.zoomOff.description: Polish in one click: what the Auto zoom step does.

polish.hint.silencesCut.description: Polish in one click: what Remove silences does with Cut chosen; {length} is the shortest pause ("1.0 s").

polish.hint.silencesFaster.description: Polish in one click: what Remove silences does with a speed chosen; {length} is the shortest pause, {factor} the speed ("4").

polish.hint.smoothCuts.description: Polish in one click: what Smooth cuts does.

polish.hint.captionsTo.description: Polish in one click: the Captions step with an AI service; {provider} is its name ("My OpenAI").

polish.hint.captionsToAny.description: Polish in one click: the Captions step with an AI service not chosen yet.

polish.hint.chapters.description: Polish in one click: what Find chapters does. Review is Review mode.

polish.hint.captionLookWide.description: Polish in one click: what Caption look does in a wide video (no pop-ups).

polish.hint.captionLook.description: Polish in one click: what Caption look does.

polish.hint.director.description: Polish in one click: what Camera director does.

polish.skip.keptLook.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the Style row when no preset is chosen.

polish.skip.off.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: a step the user turned off.

polish.skip.noInput.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: auto zoom needs recorded clicks.

polish.skip.noCuts.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: Smooth cuts needs cuts.

polish.skip.keptStyle.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the user chose a cut style already.

polish.skip.hasChapters.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the video has chapters already.

polish.skip.shortVideo.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the video is too short for chapters.

polish.skip.noSpeech.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: chapters are named from what is said.

polish.skip.noSound.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: nothing to measure for silences or captions.

polish.skip.muted.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the recording sound is muted.

polish.skip.notMeasured.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: measuring the sound failed.

polish.skip.nothingHeard.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the recording is silent.

polish.skip.hasCaptions.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: captions exist already.

polish.skip.noProvider.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: no AI service that makes captions.

polish.skip.noModel.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the free speech model on this PC is not downloaded.

polish.skip.busy.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: captions are being made already.

polish.skip.noCaptions.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: Caption look needs captions.

polish.skip.cancelled.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the user pressed Skip while the step ran.

polish.skip.noCamera.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the camera director needs a camera.

polish.skip.cameraHidden.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the camera is hidden.

polish.skip.noPreset.description: Polish in one click: why a step cannot run or was skipped: the remembered preset was deleted.

polish.skip.failedWhy.description: Polish in one click: a step that failed; {why} is the error.

polish.skip.failed.description: Polish in one click: a step that failed with no reason.

polish.skip.captionsFailedWhy.description: Polish in one click: making captions failed; {why} is the error.

polish.skip.captionsFailed.description: Polish in one click: making captions failed with no reason.

polish.phase.stopping.description: Polish in one click: the Captions row while making captions stops.

polish.phase.starting.description: Polish in one click: the Captions row as making captions starts.

polish.phase.extracting.description: Polish in one click: the Captions row while the sound is prepared for transcription.

polish.phase.uploading.description: Polish in one click: the Captions row while the sound is sent to the AI service.

polish.phase.transcribing.description: Polish in one click: the Captions row while speech is turned into text.

polish.phase.finishing.description: Polish in one click: the Captions row as making captions ends.

polish.phase.part.description: Polish in one click: the Captions row for a long recording sent in parts; {phase} is what it does ("Transcribing…").

polish.camera.intro.description: Polish in one click: a camera change of the director, in a list after "Camera:": the camera fills the frame at the start. Lower case.

polish.camera.moves.description: Polish in one click: camera bubble moves to another corner, in a list after "Camera:".

polish.camera.hidden.description: Polish in one click: how many times the camera is hidden in long silences, in a list after "Camera:" ("2 hidden").

polish.camera.outro.description: Polish in one click: a camera change of the director, in a list after "Camera:": the camera fills the frame at the end. Lower case.

polish.camera.face.description: Polish in one click: the camera was centred on the face, zoomed {zoom} ("1.4×"), after "Camera:". Lower case.

polish.camera.nothing.description: Polish in one click: after "Camera:" when the director changed nothing. Lower case.

polish.camera.already.description: Polish in one click: after "Camera:" when the camera was directed already. Lower case.

polish.camera.withFace.description: Polish in one click: the camera changes ("intro, 1 bubble move") and then the face framing ("face centred (1.4×)"), after "Camera:".

polish.result.skipped.description: Polish in one click: a summary line of a skipped step: its name, then why, starting lower case ("Auto zoom: no clicks were captured").

polish.result.styleUnchanged.description: Polish in one click: the summary line of the Style step that changed nothing.

polish.result.style.description: Polish in one click: the summary line of the Style step; {name} is the preset applied.

polish.result.styleAlready.description: Polish in one click: the Style step when the video had that preset's look already; {name} is the preset.

polish.result.zoomAlready.description: Polish in one click: the Auto zoom line when it was on already, with how many zooms there are.

polish.result.zoomOn.description: Polish in one click: the Auto zoom line with how many zooms it made.

polish.result.zoomOnKept.description: Polish in one click: the Auto zoom line with how many zooms it made and how many of the user's it kept ({kept}).

polish.result.noSilences.description: Polish in one click: the Remove silences line when no pause was long enough; {length} is the shortest pause ("1.0 s").

polish.result.noSilencesToSpeed.description: Polish in one click: the Remove silences line, with a speed chosen, when no pause was long enough.

polish.result.silencesCut.description: Polish in one click: the Remove silences line: how many pauses were cut and how much shorter the video is ({saved}, "3.5 s" or "1:12.0").

polish.result.silencesSped.description: Polish in one click: the Remove silences line with a speed: how many pauses play {factor} times as fast and how much shorter the video is.

polish.result.smoothCuts.description: Polish in one click: the Smooth cuts line: at how many cuts it set a style.

polish.result.smoothCutsUnchanged.description: Polish in one click: the Smooth cuts line when it changed nothing.

polish.result.captions.description: Polish in one click: the Captions line: how many captions were made.

polish.result.captionsLeftOut.description: Polish in one click: the Captions line when the most captions a project keeps ({max}) was reached at {time} in the video.

polish.result.chapters.description: Polish in one click: the Find chapters line: how many chapters it found.

polish.result.chaptersNone.description: Polish in one click: the Find chapters line when it found none.

polish.result.captionLook.description: Polish in one click: the Caption look line when it changed the captions.

polish.result.captionLookUnchanged.description: Polish in one click: the Caption look line when it changed nothing.

polish.result.camera.description: Polish in one click: the Camera director line; {body} lists what changed ("intro, 2 bubble moves; face centred (1.4×)").

polish.result.cameraWhy.description: Polish in one click: the Camera director line with why the face was not centred ({why}, a sentence).

polish.headline.already.description: Polish in one click: the summary's headline and the notice when nothing changed.

polish.headline.shorter.description: Polish in one click: the summary's headline; {saved} is how much shorter ("1:12.0").

polish.headline.done.description: Polish in one click: the summary's headline (and the notice's start) when the video is not shorter.

polish.notice.shorter.description: The notice after Polish in one click: its start, how much shorter the video is ("1:12.0"); what else changed follows after " · ".

polish.notice.style.description: The notice after Polish in one click: the preset applied ("Studio style").

polish.notice.autoZoom.description: The notice after Polish in one click: auto zoom was turned on. Lower case.

polish.notice.silencesCut.description: The notice after Polish in one click: how many pauses were cut.

polish.notice.silencesSped.description: The notice after Polish in one click: how many pauses play {factor} times as fast.

polish.notice.captions.description: The notice after Polish in one click: how many captions were made.

polish.notice.chapters.description: The notice after Polish in one click: how many chapters were found.

polish.notice.camera.description: The notice after Polish in one click: how many camera changes the director made.

polish.notice.cameraFace.description: The notice after Polish in one click: camera changes, and the camera centred on the face.

polish.notice.face.description: The notice after Polish in one click: the camera was centred on the face. Lower case.

polish.stylePreset.description: Polish in one click: the Style menu's name for screen readers.

polish.yourPresets.description: Polish in one click: the group of the user's own style presets in the Style menu.

polish.silenceAction.description: Polish in one click: the name of the chips that choose to cut pauses or play them faster.

polish.transcriptionProvider.description: Polish in one click: the menu that chooses what makes the captions (this PC or an AI service).

polish.skip.description: Polish in one click: the button on a running step that skips it (making captions, centring the face).

polish.run.description: Polish in one click: the button that runs the chosen steps (a verb).

polish.undo.description: Polish in one click: the summary's button that undoes the whole polish.

polish.row.waiting.description: Polish in one click: a step's row while it waits for its turn.

polish.row.measuring.description: Polish in one click: the Remove silences row while the sound is measured.

polish.row.lookingAtScreen.description: Polish in one click: the Find chapters row while the screen changes are found.

polish.row.captions.description: Polish in one click: the Captions row when its captions are made: how many.

polish.row.applying.description: Polish in one click: every running row while the edit is put together.

polish.nothingPlanned.description: Polish in one click: the error inside "Polish failed: {reason}." when planning gave nothing (lower case).
